execution_authority.reason: The plan requires human approval of the calibration packet before full screening. This record freezes a proposal; it is not an approval record.

research_questions.text: What accuracy, bias, calibration, and correlated-failure evidence exists when an LLM judges outputs from itself or the same model family?
Which fresh-context, hidden-criteria, test-generation, randomized-sampling, panel, evidence-forcing, and adversarial-role separations improve error detection, and under what conditions?
Which deterministic or formal methods bind verdicts to observable acceptance criteria for code, documents, plans, and mixed artifacts?
How should a gate handle abstention, disagreement, missing evidence, prompt injection, non-convergence, mutable artifacts, and unavailable execution?
Which assurance tiers are justified by artifact risk, and when is same-model QA insufficient without human or external authority?

mechanism_families.name: procedural separation, panels, debate, and disagreement
property-based, metamorphic, mutation, and fault-injection testing
provenance, auditability, prompt-injection resistance, and immutable evidence
abstention, escalation, risk tiers, and human authority

query_execution_rules.literal_recording: Record the exact submitted string, source, interface, filters, result count, retrieval timestamp, and URL or query identifier. Preserve any source-imposed translation of the query.

filters.document_type: source-native filters may be used only when logged

query_execution_rules.ordering: Use relevance ordering for the initial pass; if the source exposes stable date ordering, also inspect the newest results until the family ceiling or saturation condition is reached.
query_execution_rules.snowballing: For each included or provisionally included primary study, inspect references and citing works for otherwise missed primary evidence; register the seed source ID and direction.
deduplication_key_order: title plus first author plus year
query_execution_rules.version_lineage: Retain the fullest primary version as the screening record and link superseded preprint, conference, journal, report, or repository versions as duplicates rather than independent evidence.

include_all.rule: The record reports a mechanism, evaluable method, empirical result, formal property, or operational control relevant to a QA-gate decision.

The record is a public standard, original or peer-reviewed research, official vendor/model or tool documentation, a primary benchmark/dataset paper, or a mature primary software repository with inspectable tests or demonstrated behavior.
The record informs at least one research question, required candidate architecture, threat, metric, or authority boundary in the plan.
Enough text or inspectable material is available to appraise the claimed method or control; metadata-only records remain candidates but cannot be included.

exclude_any.rule: Unsourced opinion or commentary without an inspectable method, result, formal property, or operational control.
Duplicate or superseded version when a fuller primary version is registered; preserve lineage.
Marketing claim without an inspectable method, test, or evidence.
Cannot inform a QA-gate decision, listed comparison, threat, metric, or assurance boundary.
Secondary summary when the underlying primary or official source is available; retain only as a discovery pointer.
Full method or operative control cannot be inspected after documented retrieval attempts.

not_exclusion_reasons: non-English language when a reliable translation is available
screening_flow: Perform title/abstract triage; triage may include, mark uncertain, or propose exclusion but has no final exclusion authority.
Sample at least 20 percent of triage records plus every proposed borderline exclusion for higher-capability review.
Perform full-text eligibility; record exactly one primary exclusion reason and optional secondary reasons.
Send all borderline exclusions and all high-impact negative evidence to method-lead adjudication before final status.

coverage_and_stopping.early_saturation: Two successive human-approved query refinements add no new mechanism class and every required candidate-architecture comparison cell has at least one appraised source or an explicit evidence gap.
coverage_and_stopping.non_suppression: Contradictory, negative, and null evidence cannot be suppressed by early stopping.
coverage_and_stopping.count_failure: If stage counts cannot be computed from the source register, stop screening and repair the register before continuing.

Q05 added no new mechanism class
pilot_calibration.coverage: All pilot concept-map classes MC-01 through MC-08 were observed.
pilot_calibration.interpretive_limit: Pilot relevance is reversible triage, not eligibility, inclusion, appraisal, extraction, or evidence sufficiency. Pilot convergence supports freezing terminology and the proposed full query set but does not satisfy full-review evidence saturation.

known_calibration_gaps: All 25 deduplicated pilot candidates remain unscreened; no source is included, excluded, appraised, or extracted.
No query refinement may be added or materially changed after approval without a logged deviation and, when material, human approval or a vN+1 plan.
